text:
Maya A. (AE): Quick sync — SMB prospect asked for a performance POC to validate latency and unit cost. They want sustained 50 qps with 95th < 180ms and 99th < 350ms. Also asking for a rough cost/day estimate. Can we stand this up next week? @Liam K. (SE) can you lead test plan?

Liam K. (SE): Yep. I can own the harness. A couple clarifying q's: 1) input size distribution (tokens per request)? 2) model variant (open-llama-13b / quantized?) 3) expected concurrency pattern (steady vs bursts)?

Maya A. (AE): They said median request ~ 120 tokens, tails to 600 tokens. Prefer an open model (13B) quantized to int8 if we can show cost wins. Pattern is steady with occasional 200 qps bursts for <2m.

Priya R. (Perf Eng): Plan proposal: warmup 5m, ramp 10 -> 50 qps over 3m, steady 30m, 2 burst windows (2m each) at 200 qps. Capture p50/p95/p99 and CPU/GPU utilization + token/sec. We'll run variants: (A) hosted small batch (bs=1), (B) batching bs=4, (C) int8 quantized. Also test Dedicated config (pinned pods) vs Hosted fallback.

Priya R. (Perf Eng): Quick run commands (harness uses vegeta + our request proxy):
```
vegeta attack -rate=50 -duration=30m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > results-50qps.json
# bursts: vegeta attack -rate=200 -duration=2m -targets=targets-burst.txt
```
Make sure targets file includes varied prompt lengths. We'll collect metrics to CloudWatch + per-route latency traces.

Liam K. (SE): For infra, recommend A10G dedicated pool (1 replica per 12 qps baseline for bs=1). For batching we can increase qps per GPU. I'll include a table of expected GPUs and hourly cost. Also need to confirm model compile settings (flash-attn, kv cache warmup).

Noah S. (SalesOps): Pricing note — customer is SMB and wants predictable cost. We can offer a 3-month Dedicated trial at reduced hourly commit. If the POC shows cost > target, they'll ask discount. Can we estimate cost/day for each variant?

Priya R. (Perf Eng): Yes. Rough back-of-envelope: non-quantized 13B on A10G: ~ $0.48 / 1k requests at 120 tokens median (bs=1). With int8 + batching bs=4 we can drop to ~ $0.18 / 1k. I'll convert to $/day assuming 50 qps steady:
- A (bs=1, fp16): ~ $620/day
- B (bs=4, fp16): ~ $260/day
- C (bs=4, int8): ~ $95/day
(These include GPU runtime + network egress estimates, ballpark).

Liam K. (SE): Security blocker: they require SOC2 + data residency in EU for production. For the POC they can allow hosted infra in `eu-west-1` with audit logs. If they insist on VPC, we'll need Redwood Private -> longer lead time. @Noah S. FYI for contracts.

Noah S. (SalesOps): Noted. We'll ask for a signed NDA + POC addendum. Private deployment upsell doc ready if they want residency; takes ~2w to provision.

Maya A. (AE): Great. Can we schedule an initial bench run Wednesday 14:00 UTC? I'll confirm with the customer. Deliverables: test plan, runbook, cost estimates, one-page results writeup.

bench-bot: Scheduled benchmark run `run_20241106_1400` queued on infra pool `sales-poc-eu`. Notify channel with results artifact link when complete.

Priya R. (Perf Eng): I'll prepare the runbook and a short prompt set that mirrors their traffic (mix of 20/120/400/600 token requests). Will tag results with labels: variant, batch_size, quantization, region.

Liam K. (SE): I'll provision the Dedicated trial shape in eu-west-1 and set up routing policies (prefer dedicated, fallback to hosted). Also enable KV prefix caching for repeated sessions.

Maya A. (AE): Awesome. One more ask from the customer: they want a short section in the writeup comparing tail latency improvements from batching vs quantization. Priya — can you include a small chart snippet?

Priya R. (Perf Eng): Yep. I'll export p99 percentiles as CSV and attach a chart. Expected outcome: batching reduces p50/p95 but can increase p99 under burst if queueing poorly; int8 usually reduces latency and cost simultaneously.

Noah S. (SalesOps): I'll draft a POC addendum with 3-month trial pricing and an option to convert to monthly reserved capacity. Will share a doc later today.

bench-bot: Run `run_20241106_1400` started — collecting system metrics, model logs, and per-request traces. Artifacts will appear in /poc-artifacts/run_20241106_1400/ once complete.

Maya A. (AE): Thanks team — please post interim results in this thread. I'll compile the one-pager for the customer after we get numbers.

Priya R. (Perf Eng): Will do. First smoke run in ~30m and then full run Wed at 14:00 UTC.

Liam K. (SE): Leaving a checklist here:
- targets.txt with token mix ✓
- compile flags documented ✓
- infra provisioned (dev) ✓
- dedicated pool (eu) requested ✓
- runbook + CSV export ✓

Maya A. (AE): Perfect. Tag me when the results writeup draft is ready for customer review. :thumbsup:
